label: PF Backlog 531
title: Grooming completeness: populate priority + structured deps + full context (AI and deterministic), re-groom in-progress
body:
Problem: grooming only fills the analysis block. Priority and structured dependencies are left empty, and the authored context (objective/acceptance_criteria/in_scope/out_of_scope/affected_*/approach/verification/risks/rollback/evidence/review) is never refreshed - so re-grooming an existing item cannot complete it, and the scheduler has no priority/deps to order by (scheduler._rank/_unmet_deps).

Goal: one groom call (AI and deterministic) populates the FULL item context + priority + structured dependencies, gap-filling by default and overwriting with --force; groom-all also re-grooms already groomed IN_PROGRESS items so the backlog can be completed in bulk.

In scope:
- extend deterministic + AI groom to fill the context fields from the item body (real derivation; no '(derived)' placeholders; reuse core.backlog._draft_context)
- set a default priority and map explicit deps/blocked_by to structured dependencies
- gap-fill by default; --force overwrites non-empty authored fields
- groom-all re-grooms NOT_ANALYZED + IN_PROGRESS (COMPLETE only with --force)
- CLI/API flags + tests

Out of scope:
- semantic dependency inference without AI (only explicit deps are mapped deterministically)
- auto-approval of items

Acceptance:
- deterministic groom fills empty objective/acceptance_criteria/in_scope/priority/deps and still passes backlog_context_check with no '(derived)' placeholders
- --force overwrites non-empty authored fields; default never clobbers them
- groom-all includes IN_PROGRESS items; COMPLETE only with --force
- new tests + precheck green

Approach: reuse backlog._draft_context for context derivation; extend _apply_proposal to persist context/priority/deps (gap-fill unless force); extend the AI prompt to request those fields.
